input: What is your refund policy for annual plans purchased less than 14 days ago?
expected_output: Full refund within 14 days of purchase, no questions asked.

input: How do I export my workspace data before closing my account?
expected_output: Go to Settings > Data > Export, choose CSV or JSON, then confirm account closure.

input: Does the free tier include API access?
expected_output: No, API access requires the Pro plan or higher.

input: My invoice shows a charge for a plan I cancelled last month. What happened?
expected_output: Cancellations take effect at the end of the current billing cycle, so one final invoice is expected.

input: Can I downgrade from Team to Solo mid-cycle and get a prorated credit?
expected_output: Yes, downgrades are prorated and the credit is applied to the next invoice.

input: What happens to my saved projects if I let my subscription lapse?
expected_output: Projects are kept read-only for 90 days after lapse, then deleted.

input: I was charged twice for the same month. I already got a partial credit last week for a different issue. Is this new double-charge covered by the same refund policy, or does the earlier credit change what I'm owed?
expected_output: AMBIGUOUS_BY_DESIGN: reasonable answers differ on whether the prior unrelated credit affects eligibility for this separate double-charge refund; no single short answer is unambiguously correct without policy text the model was not given.

input: Is two-factor authentication required for admin accounts on the Team plan?
expected_output: Yes, 2FA is mandatory for all admin accounts on Team and Enterprise plans.
